fusions.name: Pitch-Wrapped Javelin
fusions.desc: Throws a burning javelin that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Flame-Tube Discharge
fusions.desc: Discharges a tube lashed below the blade through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 fire damage to everything in it and leaves each enemy [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Heated Rebuke
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tempered Point
fusions.desc: Conjures a shaft with a charred, hardened tip. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your fire resistance by 10%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
